title: मर्नैजति परेपछि कथासङ्ग्रहका कथामा लैङ्गिक शक्तिसम्बन्ध (Gender power relations in the stories of the anthology 'Marnejati Parepachhi')
nepali: माधवलाल कर्माचार्यको मर्नैजति परेपछि (२००९) कथासङ्ग्रह सामाजिक यथार्थवादी कथाको सङ्कलन हो । यस कथासङ्ग्रहका सोद्देश्य नमुना छनोट गरिएका ‘तिनको शृङ्गार’ र ‘तिनी फर्कंदा’ कथामा तत्कालीन पुरुषवादी सामन्ती पितृसत्तात्मक चिन्तन, चरित्र र तिनका व्यवहारको प्रतिनिधित्व गराई निरीह नारीजीवनका यथार्थलाई प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ । सर्वेक्षण, सूक्ष्म पठन तथा पाठविश्लेषणको विधि प्रयोग गरी समग्रमा विश्लेषणात्मक विधिमार्फत सामान्यीकृत निष्कर्ष प्रस्तुत गरिएको प्रस्तुत सङ्ग्रहका कथामा सांस्कृतिक अध्ययनअन्तर्गत लैङ्गिक शक्तिसम्बन्धको खोजी र विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । तत्कालीन पितृसत्तात्मक सामन्ती चिन्तन र व्यवहार भएको पुरुषमुखी लैङ्गिक सम्बन्ध र पितृसत्ताकै केन्द्रमा लैङ्गिक विचारधारा प्रतिनिधित्व गराइएको उल्लिखित कथाहरूमा वैरभावपूर्ण लैङ्गिक सम्बन्ध, नकारात्मक लैङ्गिक भूमिका, परम्परागत पितृसत्ता, हिंसा र आपराधीकरणको चित्रण गरिएको छ । निम्न वर्गीय पुरुष र नारी चरित्रका लैङ्गिक समस्याको मूल कारकका रूपमा पितृसत्तागत अहम् र दम्भ रहेको छ । यी कथामा मानिसको प्राकृतिक लिङ्गका विपरीत सामाजिक, सांस्कृतिक आधारमा निर्मित विभेदकारी लैङ्गिक सम्बन्ध स्थापित भएको छ । त्यसले पारिवारिक र सामाजिक सत्ता पुरुषका हातमा सुम्पिएर असमान लैङ्गिक सम्बन्ध निर्माण गरेको छ । यी कथामा तत्कालीन सामन्तवादी विमर्शात्मक संरचनामा उत्पादनका साधन, वितरण प्रणाली र श्रमको मूल्य निर्धारणमा नारीको सहभागिता शून्य भएकाले नारीहरूको अवस्था अधीनस्थ बनेको देखाइएको छ । कथामा प्रस्तुत सबै तथ्यहरूलाई आधार मानी तत्कालीन समाजको लैङ्गिक सम्बन्ध असमानतापूर्ण थियो भन्ने निष्कर्ष विश्लेष्य कथामा प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ ।(The anthology 'Marnejati Parepachhi'(2009) by Madhavalal Karmacharya, is a collection of social realistic stories. In the stories 'Tinko Shringar' and 'Tini Farkanda', which were selected purposefully from this collection of stories, the reality of innocent women's life is presented by representing the male feudal patriarchal thinking, character and their behavior at that time. Gender power relations have been searched and analyzed in cultural studies in this collection of  stories, which has presented generalized conclusions through analytical approach using the methods such as survey, micro-reading and text analysis. Male-dominated gender relations with patriarchal feudal thinking and behavior of that time and gender ideology represented at the center of patriarchy have been depicted in the mentioned stories of antagonistic gender relations, negative gender roles, traditional patriarchy, violence and criminalization. Patriarchal pride and arrogance are the root cause of gender problems of lower-class male and female characters. In these stories, discriminated gender relations created on social and cultural basis have been established in contrast to the natural gender of human beings. It has given family and social power in the hands of men and created unequal gender relations. In these stories, it is shown that the condition of women has become subservient due to the zero participation of women in determining the prices of production, distribution system and labor in the then feudal discursive structure. Based on all the facts presented in the story, the conclusion has been drawn that gender relations in the society at that time was unequal.)
american_english: Madhavalal Karmacharya's short-story collection Marnejati Parepachhi (2009) is a collection of socially realistic stories. In the stories "Tinko Shringar" and "Tini Farkanda" from this collection, which were selected on purpose, the reality of innocent women's lives is presented by representing the male-dominated feudal-patriarchal thinking of the time, the characters, and their behavior. Using the methods of survey, close reading, and text analysis, and presenting generalized conclusions through the analytical approach overall, gender power relations have been explored and analyzed in the stories of this collection under cultural studies. In the stories named above, which represent male-centered gender relations shaped by the patriarchal feudal thinking and behavior of the time and place gender ideology squarely at the center of patriarchy, antagonistic gender relations, negative gender roles, traditional patriarchy, violence, and criminalization are depicted. Patriarchal pride and arrogance have been the root factors behind the gender problems of lower-class male and female characters. In these stories, discriminatory gender relations built on social and cultural grounds have been established in contrast to people's natural gender. That has put family and social power in men's hands and constructed unequal gender relations. In these stories, because women's participation was zero in the means of production, the distribution system, and the setting of labor's value within the then feudal discursive structure, women's condition is shown to have become subordinate. Taking all the facts presented in the story as the basis, the conclusion that gender relations in that society were unequal has been presented in the analyzed story.
british_english: Madhavalal Karmacharya's anthology Marnejati Parepachhi (2009) is a collection of social realist short stories. In the stories "Tinko Shringar" and "Tini Farkanda" from this collection, which were purposively sampled, the reality of innocent women's lives is presented by representing the male chauvinist, feudal-patriarchal thinking of the period, the characters, and their behaviour. By employing the methods of survey, close reading and text analysis, and offering generalised conclusions by way of the analytical method as a whole, gender power relations have been examined and analysed in the stories of the present collection under cultural studies. In the stories mentioned above, which represent male-centred gender relations arising from the patriarchal feudal thinking and behaviour of the day, and gender ideology centred on patriarchy itself, antagonistic gender relations, negative gender roles, traditional patriarchy, violence and criminalisation are depicted. Patriarchal pride and arrogance have remained the root factors of the gender problems of lower-class male and female characters. In these stories, discriminatory gender relations constructed on a social and cultural basis have been established in contrast to human beings' natural gender. This has placed family and social power in men's hands and created unequal gender relations. In these stories, because women's participation was nil in the means of production, the system of distribution and the determination of the value of labour within the then feudal discursive structure, the condition of women is shown to have become subordinate. On the basis of all the facts presented in the story, the conclusion that gender relations in the society of that time were unequal has been presented in the story under analysis.
australian_english: Madhavalal Karmacharya's story collection Marnejati Parepachhi (2009) is a collection of socially realistic stories. The stories "Tinko Shringar" and "Tini Farkanda", drawn from this collection and chosen purposefully, present the reality of innocent women's lives by representing the male-dominated feudal-patriarchal thinking of the day, along with the characters and their behaviour. Survey, close reading and text analysis are the methods used, and generalised conclusions are offered through the analytical approach as a whole; within the stories of this collection, gender power relations have been investigated and analysed under cultural studies. The stories in question, which represent male-centred gender relations of the then patriarchal feudal thinking and behaviour, with gender ideology placed squarely at the centre of patriarchy, portray antagonistic gender relations, negative gender roles, traditional patriarchy, violence and criminalisation. For the gender problems of lower-class male and female characters, patriarchal pride and arrogance have been the root factors. In these stories, discriminatory gender relations built on social and cultural grounds have been set up in contrast to people's natural gender. That has handed family and social power to men and built unequal gender relations. These stories show that, because women had no part at all in the means of production, the distribution system and the fixing of labour's value in the then feudal discursive structure, women's position is shown to have become a subordinate one. On the basis of every fact presented in the story, the conclusion that gender relations in that society were unequal is put across in the story under analysis.

Out of this collection, the stories "Tinko Shringar" and "Tini Farkanda" were picked on purpose, and in them the reality of innocent women's lives is shown by representing the male-dominated feudal-patriarchal thinking of those times, the characters and how they behaved. The methods used are survey, close reading and text analysis, and overall the conclusions are generalised through the analytical method; in the stories of this collection, gender power relations have been searched out and analysed under cultural studies. In the stories mentioned, which show male-centred gender relations of the then patriarchal-feudal thinking and behaviour, with gender ideology kept right at the centre of patriarchy, we get to see antagonistic gender relations, negative gender roles, traditional patriarchy, violence and criminalisation. For the gender problems of lower-class male and female characters, patriarchal pride and arrogance have been the root cause. In these stories, discriminatory gender relations made on social and cultural lines have been set up, going against people's natural gender. That has handed family and social power over to men and built unequal gender relations. In these stories, since women's share was zero in the means of production, the distribution system and the fixing of labour's value in the then feudal discursive structure, women's condition is shown to have gone subordinate. Taking all the facts given in the story as the base, the conclusion that gender relations in the society of those times were unequal is presented in the story that has been analysed.
